integrity: The finite complex is reconstructed from the defining cube edge list. The bundled verifier exhausts all edge subsets, checks the complete face poset, certifies an acyclic discrete-Morse matching, and independently recomputes mod-2 boundary ranks and Euler characteristic.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to the ordinary matching complex of the three-dimensional cube. It does not classify higher hypercubes or higher matching complexes, and literature originality retains the residual risk of an unindexed computation under alternate terminology.
title: The cube matching complex is \(\bigvee^{4}S^2\)
